scientific_integrity: The claimed novel result is the complete prescribed-target power fiber function for the finite rectangular-band semigroup algebra, not the classical sandwich multiplication or field cyclic-group root counts. The proof establishes all finite-field, dimension and exponent cases; finite enumeration is a consistency test.
scientific_limitations: Only all-ones rank-one sandwich algebras, not arbitrary sandwich matrices.
Historical priority relative to unexamined early Munn-ring and generalized-matrix-algebra literature is not independently established.
title: Complete power-map fibers and the exceptional square-only cone in finite rectangular-band algebras
